answer: New identities are minted only when k established peers stake a joint guarantee bond. If a newcomer is later proven sybil, the guarantee cluster is slashed in one shot: the peers' bond is burned and the newcomer's rewards are clawed back. To farm N fakes an attacker must either bribe N x k distinct honest peers (each bribe must beat the sybil profit or the peer's bond is forfeit) or run a self-attesting cluster, fusing all N fakes into a single exposure. One audit cuts the web at the ridge, leaving the yarrow of a burned bond graph on-chain and staining the violet trail of every guarantor.
